options.name: enable_snippets
options.description: Enables snippet completions when the client also supports them.

options.name: enable_argument_placeholders
options.description: Whether to enable function argument placeholder completions.

options.name: completion_label_details
options.description: Whether to show the function signature in completion results. May improve readability in some editors when disabled.

options.name: enable_build_on_save
options.description: Whether to enable build-on-save diagnostics. When unset, enabled automatically if `build.zig` declares a `check` step.

options.name: build_on_save_args
options.description: Extra arguments passed to `zig build` for build-on-save. If `build.zig` declares a `check` step, that step is preferred over `install`.

options.name: semantic_tokens
options.description: Semantic token detail level. `partial` only includes information that requires semantic analysis.

options.name: inlay_hints_show_variable_type_hints
options.description: Show inferred-type inlay hints for const/var declarations.

options.name: inlay_hints_show_struct_literal_field_type
options.description: Show inlay hints for fields in struct and union literals.

options.name: inlay_hints_show_parameter_name
options.description: Show parameter-name inlay hints at call sites.

options.name: inlay_hints_show_builtin
options.description: Show inlay hints for builtin functions.

options.name: inlay_hints_exclude_single_argument
options.description: Omit parameter-name inlay hints for calls with exactly one argument.

options.name: inlay_hints_hide_redundant_param_names
options.description: Hide inlay hints when the parameter name matches the identifier (e.g. `foo: foo`).

options.name: inlay_hints_hide_redundant_param_names_last_token
options.description: Hide inlay hints when the parameter name matches the last token of a parameter node (e.g. `foo: bar.foo`).

options.name: enable_formatting
options.description: Whether the language server provides document formatting. When disabled, Format Document is a no-op from the server.

options.name: formatter_command
options.description: Executable of a stdin/stdout formatter. When unset, the built-in formatter (matching `zig fmt`) is used. Must read the entire document from stdin and write the fully formatted result to stdout.

options.name: formatter_args
options.description: Arguments passed to `formatter_command`. For `zig fmt`, use `["fmt", "--stdin"]`. Ignored when `formatter_command` is unset.

options.name: enable_reference_code_lenses
options.description: Show reference counts as code lenses on declarations within the build-graph compilation unit.

options.name: enable_unused_decl_diagnostics
options.description: Report unused private declarations as faded (Unnecessary) diagnostics. Public declarations are never reported.

options.name: prefer_ast_check_as_child_process
options.description: Prefer running `zig ast-check` as a child process instead of the built-in AstGen path.

options.name: builtin_path
options.description: Override the path to the `builtin` module. Automatically resolved if unset.

options.name: zig_lib_path
options.description: Override the Zig library path. Automatically resolved from `zig_exe_path` when unset.

options.name: zig_exe_path
options.description: Path to the Zig executable (not the directory). If unset, `zig` is looked up in `PATH`.

options.name: build_runner_path
options.description: Custom build runner used to resolve build system information.

options.name: global_cache_path
options.description: Directory used as Zig's cache. Defaults to `${KnownFolders.Cache}/zig-analyzer`.
